biggest_catch: The $50 cards are mailed 4–6 weeks after your friend pays their second full invoice — and both of you need active accounts; if your friend's account is closed, no card.
catches: Visa Reward Cards are mailed 4–6 weeks after the referral pays their second invoice in full and on time — slow payout.
No cash access on the Visa Reward Cards; usable anywhere Visa debit is accepted.
You and your friend each need an active account — "Since Rewards are not redeemable for cash, we must be able to send Visa Reward Cards to a customer with an active account."
New customers MUST use your unique referral link to sign up to be associated with your account — no link, no reward.
Qualified referral must be a new customer (not current, not a customer within the 45 days prior to enrollment).
One Visa reward card per referred Electricity Service ID (ESI-ID) in a 6-month period (fraud protection).
Veteran Energy may change the offered card amount at any time before a referral's enrollment.

steps: Log in to MyAccount on veteranenergyusa.com and click 'Referral Rewards' to get your unique referral link.
Copy and paste your unique link into email, Facebook, Twitter, etc.
Your friend signs up as a new Veteran Energy customer using your link.
Your friend pays their first two invoices in full and on time.
Both you and your friend are mailed a $50 Visa Reward Card 4–6 weeks later.
